## Summary

Completes the in-main-slot AC review for the test-failure work item [test-failure] proxy/tests/test_lifecycle_spawn.py::TestStartTtsServerPathResolution::test_relative_config_path_resolved_against_repo_root (LP-0MUHW5HH00082I9Y), a child of LP-0MUBDKDFG002W221. Root cause was a test-isolation false positive: the assertion used a raw substring check (`"proxy/proxy/scripts" not in checked`) that misfired whenever the checkout or worktree root itself ended in `-proxy`. Commit 3cf3616a replaced it with an exact repo-root-relative comparison at proxy/tests/test_lifecycle_spawn.py:484-491; the fix is integrated into `dev`/`origin/dev` and the test now passes regardless of the checkout directory name. The canonical runner's Phase 1 subprocess call stalled (infra: no output for 600s) and fell back to "manual review required" — not an explicit model verdict — so this review was completed in the main LLM slot per SA-0MT2XRGEU0009QRE. Phase 2 deep analysis was skipped (effort=Extra Small, risk=Low) per SA-0MSQ026T3009QY2L.
